name: unified_safe_system_e2r_anchored_lambdamart_v3_confirmation

confirmation_split.type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint deterministic salted hash double-cold

final_ranker.training_source: all sampled ranking groups from frozen development folds 0, 1 and 2 only

confirmation_gate.metric_semantics: candidate and baseline both use evaluate_full_candidate_ranks on the full 11081 reaction universe
confirmation_gate.material_gain: MRR delta >= 0.003 OR MAP delta >= 0.003 OR Hit@10 delta >= 0.01
confirmation_gate.derivation: The single-fold-applicable pooled no-regression and material-gain clauses are copied mechanically from the pre-development gate; no confirmation result was available when this rule was frozen.

forbidden: any change to selected ranker configuration after confirmation materialization
any change to confirmation salt or fold after reveal
training the final LambdaMART ranker on confirmation labels
using external benchmark labels or metrics for this decision
substituting score-tie AUROC for deterministic-rank AUROC inside the confirmation gate
